messages:
morgan: heads up — noticed a bunch of requests that should have decision logs but the route-eval inspector shows almost no entries for them. seen this across two tenants, same route. trace ids: 7c3b9f and 7c3baa. wondering if sampling is dropping them or something else. :eyes:
kevin: can you paste an example request / headers? is this only for requests with header overrides?
morgan: yeah looks correlated to header override flow. minimal repro curl below: 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'x-tenant: acme' -H 'x-override-routing: special-v1' https://gateway.redwood/api/generate
```
we route to special-v1 but route-eval shows no decision log for these traces. regular traffic has logs.
anya: quick thought — sampler keys are tenant-based right now (we use `tenant_id`) and I think the override header is applied after preroute in the gateway. if the sampler runs before override, it will sample based on original tenant header and then later routing changes, so logs might not attach correctly.
sam: +1 that matches previous issues. check `route_eval_sampler` in prod: we had sample_rate=0.01 and sample_key=headers.x-tenant. if the header name changes later it won't correlate.
liz: for immediate debugging you can force full decision logs for one tenant: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/internal/tenants/acme/decision-logs -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"mode":"full"}'
```
that will spike logs but will confirm if it's sampling.
deploy-bot: canary toggle applied to gateway-preroute-fix on infra-canary at 1987654300 — rollout 2/10 :rocket:
kevin: verified in prod config: `sample_key = headers.x-tenant` and sampler executed at preroute hook. override header `x-override-routing` is applied in post-preroute transformer, so sampled key is stale. fix options: 1) move sampling to post-transformer (risky), 2) include `x-override-routing` in sample key expression like `coalesce(headers.x-override-routing, headers.x-tenant)`, 3) add deterministic sticky sampling based on request_id.
maria: option 2 seems safest and smallest blast radius. also we should add unit test for header-normalization order.
morgan: option 2 would let us keep early sampling but reflect overrides — can you sketch the exact change?
kevin: will patch sampler expression to `coalesce(headers.x-override-routing, headers.x-tenant)` and add fallback to `context.tenant_id`. will also add a short-term dashboard metric `route_eval_log_rate{route=...,tenant=...}` so we can see dropouts fast. planning a hotfix branch and will coordinate a quick canary. :+1:
sam: after hotfix we should run a replay on a 1h window to ensure we didn't double-sample keys; also check storage downstream for duplicate decision-log ids.
anya: also add an integration test to the gateway where transformer order is exercised — caught us before.
liz: I'll create a grafana panel and an alert (pager if < 10 logs/min for routes with > 100 rps) — will post dash id.
kevin: ok pushing hotfix branch now, requesting review from @anya and @morgan. will tag infra on canary.
morgan: thanks all — will follow the canary and confirm with the inspector once rolled. :eyes:
